verdict.rationale: Swell exposes a scriptable REST API with environment-specific API keys (test/live) and an official CLI (@swell/cli) for initializing apps/themes and deploying serverless functions, both of which are naturally usable in automated/CI pipelines; a runtime probe confirms the CLI installs and runs keylessly via npm without interactive setup. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI-specific features (e.g., non-interactive auth tokens, GitHub Actions integration, headless deploy examples) confirming the CLI/API are officially supported for CI automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation docs, non-interactive auth flow documentation, and a first-party CI pipeline example.
